svg.title: Item Class Reconstruction status and recovery class Labels, calibration, free hierar- chy (PF, PC, FM, GP, FC, FS, HC) C Finite-order recovery of labels; invertible readout at fixed level (Thm. 16.3); free sector is an imported comparison realization; faithful readout with bounded probes (Thm. 16.7). Numerical tables recomputed. Physical quotient and deriva- tives (CVP, CVR, QD) C, D Supplied construction; its formulation as kernel of all spectator readers with operations descending is made explicit (Thm. 18.3). Quotient equivalence. Slab insertions (BS) C Bounded on the reflection quotient (Prop. 19.1). Euclidean rotations (RT, RSW, DB) C Covariance of the readout derived, not a symmetry of the lattice source (Thm. 19.3); elimination constant sharpened to 7K (Lemma 19.2). Trace candidate, Gaussian comparison, scaling maps, stress, charges (TF, IG, WS, SR, SC, LCE, LR, TS) C Recovered with retained residuals; charges are rep- resentable fields (Thm. 23.3); scaling comparison (Thm. 23.2). Full short-distance limit (TLim) C Recovered for the selected phase (Thm. 24.1); value 3 dimR g/π4 supplied by the scalar Wick calculation of the sequential part. Wightman reconstruction, OPE, contact extensions, mass-shell exclusion (sequen- tial part) C Lifted through Thms. C.1, D.1 and Prop. E.1. Coverage and amendment record – Every expanded-source heading unit and its depen- dencies are mapped in both standalone papers. Four local recovery findings and two formula amendments are resolved with their calculations in Section I.1. Selection of the gauge group, dimension, action or coupling history from source-side princi- ples E Not obtained and not claimed; inequivalent realiza- tions over the same support exist (Section 8). Positive mass gap; identifica- tion of the regulator coupling with a physical coupling be- yond the trace/Ward normal- ization – Not asserted by the source; not asserted here.
